top.line: Why the model is a choice the owner makes, and how Mistral fits at every level of a sovereign website.

in-short.line: Abstract the provider; the model is a choice; Mistral on device and in the EU; already run; one licence; a partnership.

challenge.line: If we claim sovereign, abstract the AI provider: a site rented in its brain is not sovereign.

choice.line: One OpenAI-style interface; on the device, in Europe, or any provider with the owner's key.

levels.line: Ministral 3 on the device, Mistral's API on its EU endpoint, Voxtral for voice, agent features.

terms.line: 30-day retention unless zero retention, some features outside the EU, SOC 2 and ISO stated.

licence.line: Apache 2.0 models are clean; Large 4 needs a commercial licence to be served as a service.

already.line: Mistral passed our browser test in October and was one of four models in the Swarm's run.

collaborate.line: A Mistral option on every site, Ministral on the appliances, European stretch goals, credits and a joint story.

not-one.line: Sovereignty cannot rest on one company: Mistral as the European default, never the only door.

limits.line: Nothing agreed; device fit an estimate; terms as read on 20 November.

sources.line: A reply to the idea, and Mistral's own pages read on 20 November.
